title: Cognitive API Metacognition Probe
description: Checks whether Scarlet can use the single internal metacognition route through mind_api before answering a high-risk API-shape question.

turns.message: Scarlet, prima di rispondere verifica internamente la forma delle API cognitive usando la tua unica rotta di metacognizione interna. Poi dimmi in breve quali endpoint cognitivi sono ora disponibili.

expectations.label: agent inspected the current Mind API schema
agent ran an internal metacognition step

turns.notes: This scenario uses explicit instruction so it is a regression probe for the single-route metacognition design, not a replacement for adaptive behavioral evaluation.

review_questions: Did Scarlet use schema evidence before listing cognitive endpoints?
Did the internal metacognition result change or constrain the final answer?
Did Scarlet avoid calling removed parallel cognitive routes?
